## Highlights

- Accounts and categories are now listed alphabetically everywhere: in Settings, in the Transaction and Transfer forms, and in the Movements filters. Letter case and accents don't affect the order.
- Dropdowns group their options under headings. Accounts come before Credit Cards, and Expense categories come before Income ones. Category options no longer repeat their type after the name.
- A new transaction or transfer starts on the first account and category in that order, unless you picked others last time.
- On Stats, the account balances are listed alphabetically, cash accounts first and cards after.
- "Initial balance" is now called "Opening Balance", in English and Spanish. It is what an account held, or a card owed, before its earliest movement. Your data is unchanged.

## Fixes

- Editing an account's balance, or a card's debt or limit, in Settings no longer jumps the cursor back to the name field on every keystroke.
